description: Generate an exact-rational outward numerical separation certificate from the R7-D7B nested fixed-point witness table and verify it with a standalone standard-library checker that imports no Bellman/fixed-point solver modules. The certificate proves positivity of the recorded q-span under the declared two-sided numerical guard; it does not by itself prove the real-arithmetic Bellman model, maximal continuous-domain viability, Farkas infeasibility, or implementation refinement.
